connector.registryDescription: GetYourGuide tours & activities for Claude - search, details, options, and reviews
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package getyourguide-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrischall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GYG_API_KEY

env.name: GYG_CURRENCY
env.description: Default currency for prices (ISO 4217, e.g. USD or EUR). Optional — individual tool calls can override it.

env.name: GYG_LANGUAGE
env.description: Default content language (e.g. en, de). Optional — individual tool calls can override it.
